BFA-suppressed MSigDB Hallmark pathways across the four tested cell types were: Epithelial Mesenchymal Transition; UV Response Dn; Coagulation; Apical Junction; TGF-beta Signaling; TNF-alpha Signaling via NF-kB; Inflammatory Response; KRAS Signaling Up; Hypoxia; Apoptosis; Apical Surface; Angiogenesis; IL-2/STAT5 Signaling; Complement; IL-6/JAK/STAT3 Signaling; Myogenesis; Estrogen Response Early; Hedgehog Signaling; Interferon Gamma Response; Notch Signaling; Wnt-beta Catenin Signaling; Allograft Rejection; Estrogen Response Late; Mitotic Spindle; Glycolysis; Reactive Oxygen Species Pathway; Xenobiotic Metabolism.

I called a pathway suppressed if it had negative NES with GSEA FDR q < 0.25 in all four cell types and in at least 20 of the 24 BFA cell-type × concentration contrasts. The strongest suppressed pathways by median NES were Epithelial Mesenchymal Transition, UV Response Dn, Coagulation, Apical Junction, TGF-beta Signaling, TNF-alpha Signaling via NF-kB, Inflammatory Response, KRAS Signaling Up, Hypoxia, and Apoptosis.

For the secretory-disruption mechanism specifically, the relevant suppressed Hallmark terms were Apical Junction and Apical Surface. Protein Secretion itself was not consistently suppressed, and Unfolded Protein Response was activated rather than suppressed, consistent with BFA-induced ER/Golgi trafficking disruption and ER stress.
